# m.options.fmv

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Massive's fair market value of US-listed options contracts, streamed in real time.

Call it from a session `m`, made with `dm.MassiveSession()`:

```python
m.options.fmv(symbols)
```

- [Query methods](README.md#query-methods): `blink()`, `append_only()`, `ring(capacity)`, `last_by(by='Symbol')`
- Read from: WebSocket

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Arguments

A linked argument follows the [shared rules](README.md#shared-arguments) on the dataset index.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`symbols`](README.md#symbols) | Contracts as Massive's tickers (`O:` and the OCC symbol), or `dm.ALL`. |

## Plans

How recent the data is on each of Massive's plans, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Fair Market Value (WebSocket) |
| --- | --- |
| Options Basic | Not included |
| Options Starter | Not included |
| Options Developer | Not included |
| Options Advanced | Not included |
| Options Business | Real-time |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The row's instrument, as Massive's ticker. From WebSocket `sym`: "The ticker symbol for the given security." |
| `Date` | String | The trading day of the row, as ISO yyyy-MM-dd text: the New York date of `Timestamp`. |
| `Timestamp` | Instant | The row's primary time, as an Instant. From WebSocket `t`: "The nanosecond timestamp." |
| `OptionRoot` | String | The OCC option root, read from `Symbol`: the symbol without its `O:` prefix and its last 15 characters (expiry, type, and strike), such as `SPXW` for `O:SPXW251219C06000000`. It is never mapped to the underlying: an adjusted contract keeps its own root, such as `AAPL1`. |
| `RawSymbol` | String | The symbol exactly as Massive sent it, on a row whose symbol the library can't read for the dataset's asset class. That row's `Symbol` is null. Null on every other row. The column is absent when the session's `unreadable_symbols` is `dm.OnError.RAISE`, which fails on such a row instead. |
| `Fmv` | double | Fair market value is only available on Business plans. It is our proprietary algorithm to generate a real-time, accurate, fair market value of a tradable security. For more information, contact us (https://massive.com/contact). |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant, by the local clock. Every row of one WebSocket frame shares it. It isn't Massive's time, and it isn't monotonic. |
